hypothesis: The frozen short and full-utterance CAM++ views may complement each other in open-set acceptance and rejection. Compare paired-reference and independent-score cosine fusion while keeping all gate grids unchanged; require exact S001f/S002f reproduction first.
selection_policy: For each outer fold, jointly select the complete candidate, fusion weight, unknown weight, margin weight and threshold on content-group-excluded inner queries only. Full and short source controls are fallback candidates. Exact inner-score ties prefer full, then short, then the configured mixture order. Both controls must reproduce every fold and OOF prediction before primary outer results are computed.
limitations: Repeated outer comparisons are development estimates, not an unbiased final test or a promised leaderboard score.
Unknown-person and session disjointness cannot be proved from the shared unknown label.
Inner calibration removes the query content group, whereas outer evaluation restores all outer-training references.
Only public frozen encoders are permitted; fine-tuned F003 embeddings cannot be used in this crossfit protocol.
